notes.title: Distant Garden v0.4.0 Alpha Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update: Enhanced World Generation & Gameplay Features[/h1]

[h2]New World Generation:[/h2]
[list]
[*]9 biomes influenced by temperature and humidity
[*]13 new tree/shrub types, each with corresponding wood type
[/list]

[h2]Singleplayer Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]World saving added! 5 world slots for singleplayer worlds
[*]Rename or delete saved worlds
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Enhancements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New stamina system: Prevents infinite sprinting
[*]Player movement changes
[*]New death visuals
[*]Added pumpkins and jack-o'-lanterns
[*]Wooden fences
[/list]

[h2]New Characters:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Introduced Rad and Everis as part of the game world
[/list]

[h2]Block Automata:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Water now flows downward
[*]Bamboo grows over time
[*]Snow accumulation on grass and leaves
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] Multiplayer temporarily removed for reconstruction. May return in future updates.

Thank you!
- Jackson

tags.feature: - World saving added! 5 world slots for singleplayer worlds
- New stamina system: Prevents infinite sprinting
- Introduced Rad and Everis as part of the game world
- Snow accumulation on grass and leaves

notes.title: Alpha 0.2.2!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/L8ak8EM.png[/img]
Alpha 0.2.2 is out! Changes:
- Building with vox model parts with "stamping" by toggling "build mode" with B.
- Chunks have a slight animation and sound when loading in.
- Underwater view is improved & water surface is visible underneath.
- Fixed geometry bugs caused by too wide of a near-far range on camera.

Saving singleplayer worlds will be available in 0.2.3. Multiplayer servers currently auto save their worlds (These saves may not be compatible in the future).

Thank you!

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 Alpha Released
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iKH76MN.png[/img]
Hello! As promised on the Discord, here is Alpha 0.2.1. It fixes many technical issues, addresses some user accessibility concerns, and provides the software for hosting your own server!

To host a server, go to the game's installed files after updating, and navigate to the "server" folder and launch voxelland-server.exe. You will be prompted to choose a port number, type it in and press Enter.

Enjoy! More updates will be coming soon!
